verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing platform, so data export and portability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk export, no open-format download, and no offboarding or portability path. The API endpoints for reading account activity are developer building blocks, not an export capability. The "migra" marketing line refers to migrating onto Pomelo, not leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
